mapper.select: select * from biz_maintenance_record where instrument_id = #{instrumentId} order by create_time desc

select m.*, i.instrument_name as instrumentName, i.instrument_no as instrumentNo, u.real_name as operatorUserName from biz_maintenance_record m inner join biz_instrument i on i.id = m.instrument_id and i.deleted = 0 left join sys_user u on u.id = m.operator_user_id where m.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update biz_maintenance_record set maint_type = #{maintType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
